structure.unit: Heat, Light, Power, Water and Other Utility Companies Generally
Powers of Commission in Relation to Service

law.catch_line: Commission may require transfer of gas, water or electricity by one utility to another; compensation
law.text: The Commission may require a public utility to transfer to another public utility of like business, gas, water or electricity, whenever the public health, welfare or safety shall be found to so require; provided, however, that the transferring public utility shall be compensated, at a rate fixed by the Commission, for all such deliveries by the receiving public utility.
